Plot the context-level differences between groups

Source: R/compare_groups.R
plot.transitiontrees_group_comparison.Rd

plot() draws a compare_groups() result in one of two ways. The default lollipop chart ranks the contexts by the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the groups' next-state distributions, with point size for the context's count and color separating contexts whose adjusted p-value is below alpha; it shows where, given the same history, the groups continue differently. style = "matrix" draws the pairwise distances between groups as a labeled heatmap.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'transitiontrees_group_comparison'
plot(x, style = c("divergence", "matrix"), top = 15L, alpha = 0.05, ...)

Arguments

x

A transitiontrees_group_comparison object.

style

"divergence" (default) for the ranked contexts, or "matrix" for the between-group distance heatmap.

top

Number of contexts shown by "divergence". Default 15.

alpha

False discovery rate cutoff for highlighting. Default 0.05.

...

Ignored.

Value

A ggplot object: for "divergence", one row per context with its divergence in bits; for "matrix", one tile per pair of groups with its symmetric Kullback-Leibler distance printed.

Conditions

transitiontrees_empty_result

(error) for "divergence", no context has a positive divergence.

See also

compare_groups(); plot_difference() for the next-state differences within each context.

Examples

grp <- context_tree(group_regulation_long, actor = "Actor", time = "Time",
                    action = "Action", group = "Achiever", max_depth = 1)
cmp <- compare_groups(grp, iter = 20)
plot(cmp, alpha = 0.1)

plot(cmp, style = "matrix")
